Royal Ransomware

Your network has been breached and all your files have been encrypted.

We have also exfiltrated your sensitive data including:
- Financial documents

You must pay the ransom to:
1. Receive the decryption tool to restore your files
2. Ensure deletion of your exfiltrated data

To contact us and begin negotiations:
1. Install Tor Browser
2. Visit our Tor website (address provided separately)
3. Enter your unique ID to access the negotiation portal

Your unique ID: [UNIQUE]

Do not use any third-party decryption tools. Do not modify encrypted files.
Contact us as soon as possible — the longer you wait, the higher the cost.
